title: ComfyUI
description: Generate images with ComfyUI using FLUX.1-dev (fp8)

input.name: Comfy.org API Key
input.description: Enter your Comfy.org API key to use API Nodes

input.name: Custom Checkpoint URLs
input.description: Comma-separated model URLs (Civitai page/download links, Hugging Face, or direct). Downloaded to models/checkpoints at startup. Optional filename: <url>::<filename>

input.name: Custom LoRA URLs
input.description: Comma-separated LoRA URLs, downloaded to models/loras at startup

input.name: Custom Nodes
input.description: Comma-separated Comfy Registry node ids, installed at startup. Pin versions for production: comfyui-kjnodes@1.1.2

input.name: Civitai API Token
input.description: Required for most Civitai downloads (https://civitai.com/user/account)

input.name: Hugging Face Token
input.description: Required for gated Hugging Face models

input.name: Custom VAE URLs
input.description: Comma-separated VAE URLs, downloaded to models/vae at startup

input.name: Custom ControlNet URLs
input.description: Comma-separated ControlNet URLs, downloaded to models/controlnet at startup

input.name: Custom Upscale Model URLs
input.description: Comma-separated upscaler URLs, downloaded to models/upscale_models at startup

input.name: Custom Embedding URLs
input.description: Comma-separated embedding URLs, downloaded to models/embeddings at startup

input.name: Custom Diffusion Model URLs
input.description: Comma-separated diffusion model (UNET) URLs, downloaded to models/diffusion_models at startup

input.name: Custom Text Encoder URLs
input.description: Comma-separated text encoder URLs, downloaded to models/text_encoders at startup

input.name: Runtime Provisioning
input.description: Kill switch for startup model downloads and custom node installs

input.name: S3 Bucket Endpoint URL
input.description: Upload images to S3 (e.g. https://<bucket>.s3.<region>.amazonaws.com)

input.name: S3 Access Key ID
input.description: AWS Access Key ID (if S3 upload is enabled)

input.name: S3 Secret Access Key
input.description: AWS Secret Access Key (if S3 upload is enabled)

input.name: Serve API Locally (dev)
input.description: Dev only: run a local test API

input.name: ComfyUI Log Level
input.description: Log level for ComfyUI (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL)

input.name: Websocket Reconnect Attempts
input.description: How many times to retry if the connection drops

input.name: Websocket Reconnect Delay (s)
input.description: Seconds to wait between reconnect attempts

input.name: Websocket Trace
input.description: Detailed connection logs (debug only)

input.name: Refresh Worker
input.description: Restart the worker after each job for a clean state
